      "unit": "F001:F004",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001:F004"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter, when the individual is entering or in a sterile area, or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 14 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F002",
          "F003",
          "F004"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F001:F004",
        "choice_text": "An individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about their person or accessible property in any of the following circumstances: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the person or accessible property before entering a sterile area or before boarding a screened aircraft; (2) when entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when attempting to board or onboard a screened aircraft under specified sections.",
        "logic_quote": "F001:F004",
        "references": [
          "1544.201",
          "1546.201",
          "1562.23",
          "paragraph (b)"
        ],
        "statement": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about the individual's person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F005:F008",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F005:F008"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Applies to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is qualified under one of the listed categories.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "does not apply",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F006",
          "F007",
          "F008"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F005:F008",
        "choice_text": "Paragraph (a) prohibitions do not apply to carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while performing duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.",
        "logic_quote": "F005:F008",
        "references": [
          "1544.219",
          "1544.221",
          "1544.223",
          "1546.211",
          "subpart B of part 1562",
          "Paragraph (a)"
        ],
        "statement": "Paragraph (a) prohibitions do not apply to carriage of firearms and other weapons on or about an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a weapon in performance of airport duties, authorized to carry under 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562, or authorized to carry in a sterile area under a security program."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F009:F010",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F009"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "F009:F010",
        "references": [
          "1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any loaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F009:F015",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F009",
          "F011:F015"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F012",
          "F013",
          "F014",
          "F015"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F011:F015",
        "choice_text": "Transport or offering for transport is prohibited unless all four conditions are met: (i) the passenger declares the firearm orally or in writing before checking baggage; (ii) the firearm is unloaded; (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) the container is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.",
        "logic_quote": "F011:F015",
        "references": [
          "1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or baggage in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23 any unloaded firearm(s) unless the passenger declares the unloaded firearm to the aircraft operator before checking the baggage, the firearm is unloaded, it is carried in a hard-sided container, and the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F009:F016",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F009"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",

        "choice_quote": "",

        "references": [
          "1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unauthorized explosive or incendiary in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F017",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F017"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Under 49 CFR 1540.111, in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.",
        "context_quotes": [],
        "modality_quote": "does not prohibit",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F017"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F017",
        "choice_text": "Carriage of ammunition is not prohibited in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.",
        "logic_quote": "F017",
        "references": [],
        "statement": "Section 49 CFR 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm."
      }
    },
    {

unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter, when the individual is entering or in a sterile area, or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under 14 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.choice_text: An individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about their person or accessible property in any of the following circumstances: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the person or accessible property before entering a sterile area or before boarding a screened aircraft; (2) when entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when attempting to board or onboard a screened aircraft under specified sections.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about the individual's person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under 49 CFR 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is qualified under one of the listed categories.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Paragraph (a) prohibitions do not apply to carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while performing duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) prohibitions do not apply to carriage of firearms and other weapons on or about an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a weapon in performance of airport duties, authorized to carry under 49 CFR 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562, or authorized to carry in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any loaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Transport or offering for transport is prohibited unless all four conditions are met: (i) the passenger declares the firearm orally or in writing before checking baggage; (ii) the firearm is unloaded; (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) the container is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or baggage in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23 any unloaded firearm(s) unless the passenger declares the unloaded firearm to the aircraft operator before checking the baggage, the firearm is unloaded, it is carried in a hard-sided container, and the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unauthorized explosive or incendiary in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under 49 CFR 1562.23.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Under 49 CFR 1540.111, in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Carriage of ammunition is not prohibited in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.statement: Section 49 CFR 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
unit_attributes.statement: Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing the carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
